for: a session with zero context and zero memory

files.purpose: the complete handoff: the contract, the procedures, the known limits, what must not be redone

exit_codes.0: green - a WARN (transient refusal that did not recover) is still 0
exit_codes.3: the control point crashed - never green

falsified: --self-test -> SELFTEST probes=3 falsified=2 blocked=1 expectations_met=3/3 VERDICT=PASS exit 0

refusals.reason: Google publishes no grantable OAuth scope for Keep
the Google Sites API was retired

transient_refusals.reason: Google Books backend blip - measured on 3 of 5 raw probes (01:59:41Z, 02:01:48Z, 02:05:26Z); OK on the other 2
transient_refusals.status: transient - C3.services re-probes up to 4 attempts and prints the cause; recovered -> state=HEALTHY, not recovered -> state=DEGRADED_TRANSIENT -> WARN, exit 0

handoff_commit.note: the .handoff folder is versioned - the transfer is a git pull, not a file copy; a commit cannot contain its own SHA, so the anchor is the commit that introduced the folder

secret_scan.scope: staged diff of the handoff commit

secret_scan_whole_repo.scope: whole repo index, measured 2026-10-28T02:09Z - all 4 blocks were PRE-EXISTING and already published: official example tokens (AKIA-EXEMPLU-AWS, xoxb EXEMPLU) in the Cloud-side docs under 'Mavis-Cloud - GOOGLE_Setup_Session'. None was in a file changed by this handoff update; each of the 8 changed files scanned individually returns BLOCKS=0 WARNS=0. Corrected 02:12Z: the example tokens were masked in source, so the whole-repo gate is usable instead of permanently red on old material.

human_actions_remaining: the consent click - only when Google demands it (the listener is permanent on port 80, task every 5 min)
the photo selection in the Photo Picker (everything after the click is automatic)
never_do: re-authenticate unless Google demands it and the control point shows reauth_required=true
add a Google scope without verifying it first - one invalid scope invalidates the whole consent request
read, print or copy the credential
touch the Hermes namespace - duplication is correct, sharing is not
move content between repos without comparing it - a file that is present but older is a regression
